MELATI PORTFOLIO MEDIA
Add photos and videos to this folder, then update src/siteContent.js.
Example paths: /media/product-video.mp4, /media/social-campaign.jpg, /media/ad-creative.jpg
Use type: "video" for MP4 files and type: "image" for photos.
Gallery features: category filters, next/previous, image autoplay, dot navigation,
clickable thumbnails, video controls, and full-screen image viewing.

SOCIAL LINKS
Replace placeholder URLs in the socials array in src/siteContent.js with your real links.
Included: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, WhatsApp,
Messenger, Threads, and Website.


IMAGE FILES FOR THE EXPANDED PROJECT GALLERY
Add your real image files with these exact names, or change the matching media paths in src/siteContent.js:
  replace-with-social-post-01.jpg
  replace-with-social-post-02.jpg
  replace-with-social-post-03.jpg
  replace-with-social-post-04.jpg
  replace-with-ad-creative-01.jpg
  replace-with-ad-creative-02.jpg
  replace-with-ad-creative-03.jpg
  replace-with-ad-creative-04.jpg
